Iqra Wartaq — Windows build (beta)
===================================

What you need
-------------
64-bit Windows (Windows 10 or newer).
There is no 32-bit build: the framework this app is built with produces no
32-bit Windows binaries at all.


How to run it
-------------
1) Unzip the whole folder somewhere — the desktop is fine.
   Important: do not run the app from inside the zip. Right-click the zip,
   choose "Extract All", then open the folder it makes.

2) Run mirqat.exe inside that folder.

3) Nothing is installed. Keep the other files and the data folder beside
   mirqat.exe — moved on its own, the .exe will not run.


First run: a warning from Windows
---------------------------------
The file is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a blue screen:
choose "More info", then "Run anyway".


If it says MSVCP140.dll was not found
-------------------------------------
This build carries the Visual C++ runtime files it needs, so the message
should not appear. If it does on an older machine, that machine is missing
the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime. Install it once from Microsoft:

    https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

Then run mirqat.exe again.


Internet
--------
The whole mushaf reads offline.
Recitation streams, and any surah can be downloaded to play offline after.


Removing it
-----------
Delete the folder. Nothing else: nothing was added to the system or to the
Windows registry.


Something wrong, or a suggestion
--------------------------------
